Patna High Court Computer Operator Cum Typist Answer Key 2026 – Out - Complete Details

Short Information : High Court of Judicial at Patna (Bihar) has released the Answer Key for the Computer Operator-cum-Typist (Group-C) Post. This recruitment has been issued for 48 posts. The online application process for Patna HC Computer Operator-Cum-Typist Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 17 April 2026, to 16 May 2026. The CBT-I examination was conducted from 22 July 2026. Candidates must Download their Patna HC Computer Operator-Cum-Typist Answer Key 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 17 April 2026
  • Last Date : 16 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 19 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 22 July 2026
  • Admit Card : 15 July 2026
  • Answer Key : 31 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, EBC, BC : Rs. 1100/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 550/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Answer Key

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the answer key link.
  3. Select your exam date / shift / paper code.
  4. Download the answer key PDF.
  5. Calculate your expected marks and raise objections if any by the specified deadline.
